title: All good
body: Nothing needs your attention right now.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving mascot illustration.
Asset type: one full-body transparent illustration concept of Bram for Goho's "Nothing needs attention" state. The feeling is a calm reassuring "all good". This is a small supportive gesture, not a celebration.

INPUTS: Image 1 is original Bram and the authoritative identity/proportions reference. Image 2 is the approved no-receipts artwork and a supporting reference for subtle texture and soft lighting only. No receipt in this new illustration.

BRAM: Match the original broad, squat, bottom-heavy periwinkle-lilac body, soft low dome with no separate head or neck, exactly two small cream-ivory horns, tiny short feet, large long thick rounded arms and glossy dark oval eyes with original white highlights. Preserve original width and tiny feet. Fine matte clay-like skin with extremely subtle texture and warm studio lighting; no shiny toy plastic, fabric, fur, outlines or seams.

POSE: Standing calmly on both tiny feet, almost front-facing with a very slight friendly tilt toward the viewer. Shoulders low and relaxed. His left arm (viewer right) bends naturally forward and upward to chest height in a small reassuring THUMBS UP. Make the gesture easy to read but preserve Bram's original soft character design: the end of his big rounded arm becomes one simple rounded closed-mitten shape, with one short plump rounded thumb emerging from its upper side and pointing up. The tucked fingers are one smooth mass; no separate finger segments, knuckles, fingernails, narrow wrist, glove cuff, human palm or skin colour. The hand is lilac and continuous with the original long thick arm, no detached piece. Keep the thumb proportional and modest, not a giant extended finger. The raised hand stays beside his body below the face, never covers eyes, smile or horn. His other arm hangs long and relaxed beside his belly as in the original. Most of his broad belly remains visible. Both arms remain round in every direction and substantial, not fins or thin flaps.

EXPRESSION: Original simple small CLOSED curved smile. Eyes warmly meet the viewer, open with original dark oval shape. A quiet satisfied and reassuring expression: "all good, I've got you." No wide-open mouth, tongue, teeth, brows, blush, wink, nose or extra facial anatomy. No jump, shout, big wave or party pose.

PALETTE AND SCENE: Only Bram's lilac/periwinkle, his ivory horns, dark eyes and smile, and their natural shading. Absolutely no coloured props, streamers, confetti, sparkles, floating hearts, checkmarks, badges, receipt, costume, text or extra character. No lettering "all good"; communicate it entirely through his warm expression and thumbs-up.

COMPOSITION: One full-body Bram, centered, approximately 660:570 landscape close to square canvas. He fills the frame comfortably with 8 percent clear transparent margins around every visible object. His normal long hanging arm, both horns, thumb and both tiny feet fully inside the canvas. Maintain original broad squat silhouette, not a tall round teddy-bear shape. Small soft neutral translucent contact shadow immediately under his feet. No floor disc, card, background scene or backdrop.

OUTPUT: true alpha transparency with clean softly antialiased edges blending directly into alpha; no white matte, bright fringe, scattered cutout specks, glow, colour halo or painted checkerboard. Preserve subtle interior texture while keeping silhouette smooth. The asset should sit comfortably on warm off-white or dark violet-charcoal app backgrounds and read at 220 by 190 dp. Original Bram likeness and quiet reassurance are the priorities.
notes: User-approved calm thumbs-up artwork, copied unchanged. One transparent PNG is used in both themes. No confetti, streamers or additional character poses.
